title: FIW München
content:
FIW Muenchen (Forschungsinstitut fuer Waermeschutz e.V. Muenchen), founded in 1918 and based in Graefelfing near Munich, is one of Europe's oldest institutes dedicated to thermal insulation. Recognized by the Bavarian state as a materials testing institute, it is an approved testing, monitoring, and certification body for construction products under German and European building inspection rules.

Services cover thermal conductivity measurement (DIN EN 12664/12667, ISO 8301, ASTM C177) from about -180 °C to +900 °C, reaction-to-fire classification, mechanical and hygric testing, maximum service temperature (DIN EN 14706), U-mark and VDI-mark certification, plus research, consulting, and DIN, CEN, and ISO standardization work. These capabilities make FIW Muenchen directly relevant for validating aerogel insulation products for buildings and technical installations.
